BiblicalUsage: Chaber is a companion, a fellow, one knit to another. All Israel gathered against Gibeah knit together as one man, the King is anointed above His fellows, the man who robs his parents is the companion of a destroyer, and two are better than one because if one falls the other lifts up his fellow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe companionship is a moral choice: you are either knit to God's people or companion to a destroyer. There is no third company to join.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
